source_title: GBU Greater Noida Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 53 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 53 · Posts: Professor (5), Associate Professor (10), Assistant Professor (38) · Job Type: State University Teaching Appointment (initial contract-cum-probation) · Application Mode: Offline (post) + email · Fee: ₹2,000 (UR/EWS/OBC), ₹1,500 (SC/ST), ₹1,000 (PH) · Last Date: 13 November 2026 by 05:30 PM · Location: Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh · Selection: Screening + Interview · Pay: Academic Level-10 to Level-14
Contract-cum-probation for one year with Academic Level-10 to Level-14 pay: Gautam Buddha University (GBU), a state university in Greater Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, has opened 53 faculty positions for Indian Nationals.
The university, established under the Uttar Pradesh Gautam Buddha University Act 2002 and recognised by UGC under Section 12-B, seeks candidates with strong academic and research records for teaching and research roles across its schools. Applications must reach the Registrar by post by 13 November 2026 at 05:30 PM, with a scanned copy emailed the same day.
Posts cover Professor (5), Associate Professor (10) and Assistant Professor (38), distributed across specialisations in Engineering, Vocational Studies and Applied Sciences, ICT, Humanities and Social Sciences, Biotechnology, Buddhist Studies, Law and Management. Detailed specialisation-wise vacancies and exact eligibility appear in the official advertisement.
Applications must arrive as a hard copy by Speed/Registered Post or Courier and a single PDF scanned copy by email by 13 November 2026, 05:30 PM. Late receipts are not accepted; the university is not responsible for postal delay.
Envelope must be superscribed exactly: Advertisement No. GBU/Admin/TS/2026-09 Dated: 14.10.2026, Post applied for: [Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor] and Subject/Specialisation.
Fee is non-refundable and payable only by NEFT/RTGS. Note the UTR/Reference Number on the form. Duplicate or incomplete applications are not processed.
In-service candidates must route the application through proper channel or produce NOC at the interview stage.
Official notice: GBU Faculty Recruitment Detailed Advertisement PDF (Advt. No. GBU/Admin/TS/2026-09, 14 October 2026)
Official website/recruitment page: GBU Recruitment page
Application forms: Separate PDF/Word forms for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor available on the recruitment page

Ph.D. + 10 years teaching/research + research score 120 (or outstanding professional contribution) → Professor – 5 posts Ph.D. + 8 years experience + research score 75 → Associate Professor – 10 posts Master’s 55% (or equivalent) + NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016 → Assistant Professor – 38 posts
Specialisations are listed school- and department-wise in the advertisement (examples include Geospatial Data Science, Botany, Applied Physics, Buddhist Studies, Law, Business Management and others). Candidates must match the exact specialisation printed for the post they choose. Reserved-category candidates receive the relaxations printed under UGC/GBU norms.
No domicile restriction is printed for Indian Nationals. Category-wise seats follow the printed roster (UR, OBC, SC, EWS).
No correction window is printed in the advertisement.

What Posts Are Available? – GBU Vacancy & Eligibility 2026
The advertisement prints an overall category-wise roster and detailed school/department/specialisation tables. Summary of the three cadres:
Vacancy interpretation note: Assistant Professor posts form the large majority (38 of 53). Higher cadres are limited. Exact specialisation and school-wise allocation (including any horizontal reservations) must be verified from the detailed tables in the official PDF before applying.
Professor: Ph.D. in concerned/allied/relevant discipline; minimum 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals; total research score of 120 as per Appendix II (Table 2 of GBU Academic Ordinance); minimum 10 years teaching experience in university/college as Assistant/Associate/Professor or equivalent research experience with evidence of guiding doctoral candidates. An alternative route for outstanding professionals with significant contribution is also printed.
Associate Professor: Good academic record with Ph.D.; Master’s with at least 55% marks; minimum 7 publications; research score of 75; minimum 8 years teaching and/or research experience equivalent to Assistant Professor.
Assistant Professor: Master’s degree with 55% marks (5% relaxation for reserved categories as per Clause 3.4) in concerned/allied subject; cleared NET/SLET/SET or PhD as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016 (foreign Ph.D. from top-500 ranked universities also accepted).
Age limit: As per UGC/GBU Norms (numeric upper limits and category-wise relaxations are not printed with specific years in the advertisement). Relaxation follows applicable rules — confirm exact entitlement from the full notice or UGC norms before applying.
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check your age against any applicable UGC upper limit once you confirm the exact cut-off and relaxation from the advertisement.
What Is the Remuneration? – GBU Faculty 2026
Pay is printed as Academic Pay Levels under the GBU/UGC framework:
Professor: Academic Level-14 — ₹1,44,200 – ₹2,18,200
Associate Professor: Academic Level-13A — ₹1,31,400 – ₹2,17,100
Assistant Professor: Academic Level-10 — ₹57,700 – ₹1,82,400
Initial appointment is on contract-cum-probation for one year (extendable by a maximum of one year). Exact in-hand amount depends on the starting cell, applicable DA, HRA and deductions under university rules and is confirmed in the appointment letter. No further indicative take-home calculation is made here because the notice does not print DA/HRA percentages or starting cell for this drive.
Payment is only by NEFT/RTGS to: Punjab National Bank, Account No. 6660000100000025, IFSC: PUNB0666000, Branch: Gautam Buddha University Campus, Greater Noida. Write the UTR/Reference Number on the application form. Fee is non-refundable. The advertisement states that fees once paid will not be refunded.
Download the prescribed application form for the exact post (Professor / Associate Professor / Assistant Professor) from the GBU Recruitment page .
Fill the form and attach self-attested copies of all required documents (degrees, publications list, research score sheet if applicable, experience certificates, category certificate, fee payment proof).
Pay the fee by NEFT/RTGS and note the UTR.
Place the filled form and documents in an envelope superscribed: “Advertisement No. GBU/Admin/TS/2026-09 Dated: 14.10.2026, Post applied for: [Post Name] and Subject/Specialisation”
Send by Speed Post / Registered Post / Courier only to: The Registrar, Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida, Gautam Buddh Nagar-201312, Uttar Pradesh, India.
Simultaneously email a single PDF of the duly filled form (and attachments as applicable) to facultyrecruitment2026@gbu.ac.in .
Both hard copy and email must reach by 13 November 2026, 05:30 PM.
Missing the exact envelope superscription or sending to a general address instead of the Registrar.
Submitting only the hard copy or only the email (both are required).
Not writing the UTR number on the form or paying by any mode other than NEFT/RTGS.
Applying for a specialisation or category that does not match the printed vacancy.
Assuming postal delay will be excused — the notice states the university is not responsible for delay.
जीबीयू ग्रेटर नोएडा फैकल्टी भर्ती 2026 – 53 प्रोफेसर, एसोसिएट और असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर पदों के लिए ऑफलाइन आवेदन
गौतम बुद्ध विश्वविद्यालय, ग्रेटर नोएडा ने 53 फैकल्टी पदों (प्रोफेसर 5, एसोसिएट प्रोफेसर 10, असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर 38) के लिए विज्ञापन जारी किया है। प्रारंभिक नियुक्ति एक वर्ष के लिए कॉन्ट्रैक्ट-कम-प्रोबेशन पर होगी। अंतिम तिथि 13 नवंबर 2026 शाम 5:30 बजे है।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? प्रोफेसर के लिए पीएचडी, 10 प्रकाशन और 10 वर्ष अनुभव; एसोसिएट प्रोफेसर के लिए पीएचडी, 7 प्रकाशन और 8 वर्ष अनुभव; असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर के लिए मास्टर डिग्री 55% के साथ नेट/सेट या यूजीसी नियमों के अनुसार पीएचडी। विस्तृत स्पेशलाइजेशन आधिकारिक विज्ञापन में देखें।
वेतन और चयन अकादमिक लेवल-10 से लेवल-14 तक। चयन स्क्रीनिंग और इंटरव्यू पर आधारित है। कोई लिखित परीक्षा अनिवार्य नहीं बताई गई है जब तक आवेदकों की संख्या बहुत अधिक न हो।
आवेदन कैसे करें? फॉर्म वेबसाइट से डाउनलोड करें, फीस एनईएफटी/आरटीजीएस से जमा करें, रजिस्ट्रार के पते पर स्पीड पोस्ट से भेजें और स्कैन कॉपी facultyrecruitment2026@gbu.ac.in पर ईमेल करें। दोनों 13 नवंबर 2026 तक पहुँचने चाहिए। विस्तृत जानकारी www.gbu.ac.in/recruitment पर उपलब्ध है।
Shortlisting by a screening committee (a written test may be conducted if the number of applicants for a post is large, typically above 30–50 as indicated in references to the process). Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview (with presentation). Final selection is based on interview performance, academic record, research credentials and experience, subject to document verification, medical examination by a Government Hospital/Medical Institute and police verification. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. No interview stage is mandatory for every applicant; only shortlisted candidates are invited.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take
This is a state-university faculty drive on an initial one-year contract-cum-probation, not a regular confirmed post from day one. Compared with typical UGC-regulated state university advertisements that also use Academic Levels, the short initial tenure is the main difference candidates must weigh.
Best fit: Researchers and teachers who already meet the research-score and experience thresholds for Professor or Associate Professor posts, or fresh NET/Ph.D. holders targeting Assistant Professor seats in the listed specialisations, and who can relocate to Greater Noida.
Who should skip: Candidates seeking immediate permanent confirmation or those whose specialisation does not match any printed vacancy. Serving employees without a clear path to NOC should also consider the routing requirement carefully.
Practical tip: Download the exact post-wise application form, complete the research-score self-assessment sheet if required, and post the packet at least 7–10 days before 13 November so that both the hard copy and the email copy arrive safely. What is the last date to apply for GBU Faculty Recruitment 2026?
13 November 2026 by 05:30 PM for both the hard copy (post) and the scanned copy (email). No extension has been announced as of 20 October 2026.
What is the age limit for GBU Faculty posts?
As per UGC/GBU Norms. The advertisement does not print specific numeric upper limits or category-wise extra years. Confirm the exact applicable limit and any relaxation from the full notice or current UGC norms before applying.
Is there an exam for GBU Faculty, or is it interview-based?
Primarily screening followed by interview. A written test may be held only if the number of applicants for a post is large. Final selection rests on interview, academic record and research credentials after document verification.
What is the salary of GBU Faculty posts?
Academic Level-14 (₹1,44,200 – ₹2,18,200) for Professor, Level-13A (₹1,31,400 – ₹2,17,100) for Associate Professor and Level-10 (₹57,700 – ₹1,82,400) for Assistant Professor. Exact in-hand is determined by the starting cell and university rules in the appointment letter.
Can final-year students or result-awaited candidates apply?
The essential qualifications must be possessed by the last date of application. Candidates awaiting final results should not assume eligibility unless the degree/certificate is already obtained.
Is GBU Faculty a permanent government job?
The notice does not use the phrase “permanent government job.” Initial appointment is on a contract-cum-probation basis for one year (extendable by a maximum of one year). Service conditions follow the university’s framework and applicable norms.
Can candidates from other states apply?
Yes. The advertisement invites applications from Indian Nationals. No state domicile restriction is printed.
